source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Numbers 1–2. All 88 exact original records are hashed, including the written/read annotation at 1:16. Deuel at 1:14 and Reuel at 2:14 are retained. Later book numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves standards, distinct signs, ancestral houses and surrounding distance without inventing banner pictures or a measured radius.
Retains both east and sunrise imagery, camp versus tribe, divisions and the named leader-father relationship.
Distinguishes the three-tribe camp subtotal from Judah’s own count and preserves first place in the march.
Keeps Reuel as the pinned Hebrew reads here, distinct from Deuel at 1:14; a note makes the consequential name variation visible.
Preserves the southern subtotal and second marching position without conflating camp and tribal counts.
Preserves the sanctuary and Levites’ central position and the correspondence between camping and marching, without supplying a detailed transport sequence.
Preserves the western camp’s combined total and third position after the central Levite arrangement.
Preserves the northern subtotal and last rather than silently replacing it with fourth; closes divine speech before the narrative total.
Keeps the repeated grand total and household/division organization, without treating it as the population including women and children.
